title: Axolotl reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 72 Q10 70 8 58 Q14 64 22 62' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <path d='M22 72 Q10 70 8 58 Q14 64 22 62' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='20' ry='10' fill='#ff9eb5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='46' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ffc4d6'/>
  <!-- head top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='40' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#ffd6e3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- left gill stalks -->
  <path d='M30 38 Q18 28 14 22' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 38 Q16 34 10 30' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 42 Q20 40 12 42' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left gill frills -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <!-- right gill stalks -->
  <path d='M66 38 Q78 28 84 22' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 38 Q82 34 88 30' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 42 Q76 40 88 42' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right gill frills -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#3a1c2e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#3a1c2e'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 51 Q48 55 53 51' stroke='#e05580' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='49' r='3' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='49' r='3' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- left arm holding book -->
  <path d='M30 64 Q26 68 30 75' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm holding book -->
  <path d='M66 64 Q70 68 66 75' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <rect x='32' y='62' width='17' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <rect x='49' y='62' width='17' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='62' width='2' height='14' fill='#1e88e5'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='36' y1='67' x2='45' y2='67' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='71' x2='44' y2='71' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='67' x2='62' y2='67' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='71' x2='63' y2='71' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book cover edge -->
  <rect x='32' y='62' width='34' height='2' rx='1' fill='#81d4fa'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff9eb5'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff9eb5'/>
</svg>
